snippet.title: 『Lost Museum -Echoes of the Chromageists-』Teaser PV【Happinet Indie Collection】
snippet.description:
Forgotten masterpieces with stories still left to be told...
『Lost Museum -Echoes of the Chromageists-』Nintendo Switch 2/Steam Coming Summer 2027.

■STORY
Chromageists
These are beings born of the thoughts, emotions, and memories contained in paintings.
 
Behind the distinctive, unusual visage of each Chromageist
lies a mind missing vital memories.

One day, a boy named Vince wanders into their home: a place known as the "Lost Museum".

Within the museum, he finds a magic pen with mystical powers.
Pen in hand, he draws ever closer to the Chromageists—
to the emotions they hold and the mystery behind their lost memories.

Official HP：https://lostmuseum.happinet-games.com/
Steam：https://store.steampowered.com/app/5099440
Official X：https://x.com/lostmuseum_ofcl
Official Instagram：https://www.instagram.com/lostmuseum_ofcl/
